Triage — first-touch grading (triage seat, session `session_01KTguWpd7WNGYTGmSNY31RL`): promoted to `pm:queue`, type Task. Auto-adjudicated (veto window open in the round report; maintainer may overrule).

Adjudication — **option A**: delete the two dead `paths` entries and empty `KNOWN_MISSING_TARGETS` in the #4804 guard. Grounds: the card's own measurements (zero in-repo imports of either specifier, zero `package.json` declarations, positive control on `@objectstack/spec` proves the grep), so the deletion is behaviour-neutral config hygiene — the guard's exemption list was designed to be emptied by exactly this card. Option B (making `plugin-msw`/`objectql` real dependencies) is a new-runtime-dependency product decision that must not be back-derived from a dead config line; choosing A today does not foreclose B — if the mock stack is ever wanted in-repo, the dependency gets added properly then, and the docs examples serve downstream users without needing this repo's paths map either way.

Dev note: closing action is exactly the card's own — remove both lines, empty `KNOWN_MISSING_TARGETS`, and the #4804 guard then enforces "every declared target exists" with no exemptions.

## This is a FOLDED dispatch — #4820 (chain head) + #5380

Both cards are the same defect: **a config table declares a target that does not exist, and a shrink-only ratchet in the guard carves it out pending this card.** The fold is not a convenience — it is forced by a measurement:

> **Both ratchet lists live in the same file.** `KNOWN_MISSING_TARGETS` (#4820) and `KNOWN_MISSING_PACKAGE_ALIAS_TARGETS` (#5380, at `:804`) are both in `scripts/__tests__/vitest-config-alias-targets-3944.test.ts`.

Serialising them would pay the rebase tax twice on one file for two three-line edits. Fold gates, checked rather than asserted:

| gate | status |
|:--|:--|
| ① same defect shape, same fix | ✅ dead declaration + empty its ratchet entry, identically |
| ② one package/area, one worktree/changeset/queue slot | ✅ proven — same guard file |
| ③ every member already adjudicated, ⛔ none in the decision box | ✅ both ruled **direction A**, see below |
| ④ each member independently verifiable | ✅ distinct named criteria per card, below |
| ⑤ exclusion list stated | ✅ below |

`#5380` carries its own claim comment pointing at this branch; it has no branch of its own **by design**, not as a half-state.

## Adjudications — ⛔ already made, do not re-open

Both forks are closed. This dispatch does **not** reopen them:

- **#4820 → option A** (triage seat, 2026-08-18): delete the two dead `paths` entries, empty `KNOWN_MISSING_TARGETS`. Verbatim grounds: *"Option B (making `plugin-msw`/`objectql` real dependencies) is a new-runtime-dependency product decision that must not be back-derived from a dead config line."*
- **#5380 → option A** (triage seat, 2026-08-21): delete the dead alias line, by inheritance from the #3593 sibling ruling. Verbatim: *"Same PR must remove the `KNOWN_MISSING_PACKAGE_ALIAS_TARGETS` carve-out entry, or #5168's shrink-only pin goes red."*

⛔ Adding either package as a dependency, or creating `src/app-data`, is **out of scope and maintainer-floor**. If you find evidence that forces direction B, **stop and report a fork** — ⛔ do not implement B, and ⛔ do not quietly fall back to A-with-caveats.

## Premises — PM-verified on `origin/main` @ `e52fac0`, re-verify before editing

| premise | PM reading |
|:--|:--|
| the two `paths` entries still exist | ✅ `tsconfig.json:34,35` |
| neither package is installed | ✅ `node_modules/@objectstack/` holds only `spec` |
| `@app` alias still declared | ✅ `packages/runner/vite.config.ts:25` |
| `packages/runner/src/app-data` absent | ✅ 8 entries under `src/`, none of them `app-data` |
| both ratchet lists still carve these out | ✅ same file, `:804` for the alias half |

Positive control on the grep (an empty result is not a reading): the same pattern against `@objectstack/spec` hits in 39 `package.json` files.

**The one live nuance, measured:** the two `@objectstack/*` specifiers *do* appear in prose — `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:259,261` and `content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx:56`. Those are **downstream-user examples** and need no `paths` mapping in this repo. ⛔ **Do not touch `skills/**`** — it is a governed surface and would turn this into a draft-only, human-merge PR for no benefit. ⛔ Do not touch the `.mdx` either.

## Independent acceptance criteria — one per member, neither may silently go missing

- **#4820**: `tsconfig.json` no longer declares `@objectstack/plugin-msw` or `@objectstack/objectql`; `KNOWN_MISSING_TARGETS` is **empty**; the #4804 `describe` passes with **no exemptions**.
- **#5380**: `packages/runner/vite.config.ts` no longer declares `@app`; its `KNOWN_MISSING_PACKAGE_ALIAS_TARGETS` entry is removed; #5168's shrink-only pin passes.

One commit per card, and one `Fixes #<n>` line each in the PR body.

## ⛔ Exclusion list — things that look like this family and are NOT in it

Named because a blind "fix all the dead aliases" sweep is exactly the failure this gate exists to prevent:

1. **The other 24 package `vite.config.ts` files** with alias tables, and the root `vitest.config.mts` alias table. In scope for the guard to *read*; ⛔ **not** in scope to edit. A new dead target found there is a **finding to file**, not this PR's work.
2. **The ~10 live `@object-ui/*` entries** in root `tsconfig.json` — all resolve; ⛔ do not touch.
3. **The six lines #4804 already removed** (`REMOVED_BY_4804`) — already gone; that pin stays as-is.
4. **`@object-ui/data-objectql`** referenced in the runner config's comment (the #3593 case) — already handled; ⛔ not a second deletion.

## Gates to run

objectui has no `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, so this list is derived from the diff by hand and you must re-derive it against what you actually change: `scripts/__tests__/vitest-config-alias-targets-3944.test.ts` (the direct guard, **both** `describe` blocks), Type Check, Lint. Changeset: the diff touches no published `src/` — judge `skip-changeset` vs a changeset against the repo's own rule and **state which and why** in the report.

Report the ratchet lists' before/after contents verbatim — they are the machine-checkable core of both cards.

## ⛔ Claim VOIDED — never dispatched. Card is back in the queue, unchanged.

The [claim above](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/4820#issuecomment-5392930584) is **withdrawn**. `pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue` and the assignee cleared, verified on read-back.

**Provenance of this withdrawal** — the maintainer, in the live `/pm-dispatch devx@objectui` session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`, 2026-08-24 ~08:55Z, verbatim:

> 你进入收尾模式，先别派新活了，我要换git账户，然后你教下我怎么换

Recorded verbatim because a withdrawal without provenance is indistinguishable from a mis-sweep, and a sibling seat would be right to reopen it.

### State, so the next seat does not re-derive any of it

**No `os-dev` agent was ever launched. No branch, no worktree, no PR, no edit.** The claim comment was written and the labels flipped; the stop order arrived before dispatch. Nothing on `main` moved.

⚠️ **The analysis in the voided claim is still good and was measured against `origin/main` @ `e52fac0` this morning** — reuse it rather than re-deriving:

- Both ratchet lists are in **one file** (`scripts/__tests__/vitest-config-alias-targets-3944.test.ts`), `KNOWN_MISSING_PACKAGE_ALIAS_TARGETS` at `:804`. That is why #4820 and #5380 were folded, and the reason survives this withdrawal.
- Both cards' forks are **already adjudicated to direction A** (this card 2026-08-18; #5380 2026-08-21). ⛔ Still do not re-open them.
- Premises re-verified today: `tsconfig.json:34,35` still declare both dead entries; `node_modules/@objectstack/` still holds only `spec`; `packages/runner/vite.config.ts:25` still declares `@app`; `packages/runner/src/app-data` still absent. Positive control: the same grep hits `@objectstack/spec` in 39 `package.json` files.
- ⛔ `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:259,261` and `content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx:56` mention the two specifiers as **downstream-user examples**. Do not touch them — `skills/**` is governed and would force the PR draft-only for no benefit.
- The ⛔ exclusion list in the voided claim (24 other `vite.config.ts` alias tables, the live `@object-ui/*` paths, `REMOVED_BY_4804`, `@object-ui/data-objectql`) stands.

The fold with **#5380** remains the recommended shape for whoever picks this up.
